name: Visual Memory
description: Checks every inbound image against the local Visual Memory register (vm.py) and provides the result to the agent as next-turn context.

enabled.description: Master switch for the image check hook.

workspaceDir.description: Workspace containing scripts/visual-memory (the vm.py tool repository). Defaults to the OpenClaw workspace under the host user home (~/.openclaw/workspace).

venvRelPath.description: Python interpreter path relative to workspaceDir.

checkTimeoutMs.description: Hard timeout for one vm.py check run; on timeout nothing is injected.

maxImageSizeBytes.description: Images larger than this are skipped (guard against oversized media).

maxImageAgeMs.description: Skip images whose mtime is older than this (stale replay guard).

injectionTtlMs.description: Next-turn injection TTL: results that arrive after this window are dropped instead of injected into an unrelated turn.

stagingRetryMs.description: Delay before the single staging-pending retry probes originalMedia paths (existence-guarded).

mediaDir.description: OpenClaw media store root; media://inbound prompt-note aliases resolve under <mediaDir>/inbound. Defaults to ~/.openclaw/media.

diagLogPath.description: Decision-path diagnostics log file (metadata only, 1 MB size cap). Defaults to ~/.openclaw/logs/visual-memory-hook.log.

transcriptDir.description: Directory for per-run JSONL transcripts (Active-Memory analogue). Defaults to ~/.openclaw/plugins/visual-memory/transcripts.

transcriptMaxFiles.description: Retention: keep at most this many transcript files; the oldest are pruned after each run.
